title: haij CLI config.json
description: Spec 30 Phase 3 (test #52). Schema for ~/.config/haij/config.json — the haij CLI's persistent profile store. The CLI writes this file on `haij auth login` and reads it on every subsequent invocation. A profile is fully self-contained (base URL + bearer + tenant identifiers) so the CLI can switch tenants in one shell with `--profile`.

profiles.description: Map of profile name → profile object. The profile name is the `--profile` flag value (e.g. `staging`, `prod`, `demo`).

default_profile.description: Profile name used when no `--profile` flag and no `HAIJ_PROFILE` env var is set. Must reference a key under `profiles`.

token.description: Bearer credential. Either a long-lived ApiKey (`haij_<64hex>`) or a device-flow access token (haij_<urlsafe>).

company_id.description: UUID v7 of the tenant company. Cached so the CLI can include it in agent introspection (`haij commands --json`) without an extra round-trip.

company_slug.description: Human-readable tenant slug — surfaced in breadcrumb messages.

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the profile was created. Used for audit + entitlement TTL calculations.

plan.description: The tenant's plan as `GET /api/v1/whoami` reported it at login. Shown by `haij auth whoami`. Absent when the server did not report one.

scopes.description: The API key's scopes (e.g. `read`, `write`) as `GET /api/v1/whoami` reported them at login. Absent when the server did not report any.

entitlements.description: Optional cached plan-feature snapshot. Refreshed on a 24-hour cadence (test #14). Absent on a freshly-issued profile until the first command runs.
